name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 3 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the reform of the European Electoral Act – hurdles to ratification and implementation in the Member States
part_text: 3a. Considers that differences in the implementation of Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2018/994 reflect legitimate constitutional choices made by Member States in accordance with their democratic processes; stresses that the absence of uniform transposition cannot be interpreted as a lack of commitment to democracy, but rather as an expression of the pluralism inherent to the Union;
